warnings: This scanned สพฐ./กรมสามัญศึกษา set (อาคารหอประชุม 100/27, ปรับปรุง 2530) prints NO grid bubbles on any sheet — only dimension chains. Labels were assigned (house-70 precedent): numbers 1-11 on the column lines every 4.00 along x (0.00 to 40.00) plus 12 on the control-room column line at 42.00; letters A-F on the column rows along y (A 0.00 and F 26.00 = left-wing outer rows, B/E = F2C2 rows, C/D = F1C1 rows). Every named line carries grid_label_assigned_not_printed.

Origin = grid 1 / row A (top-left corner of the left wing). x chain: 4.00 x 10 + 2.00 = 42.00 on S-4, 1.50 + 4.00 x 10 + 1.50 = 43.00 on S-5 (roof edges at -1.50 and 41.50). y chain: 2.50 + 7.00 x 3 + 2.50 = 26.00 (S-4), 1.00 + 2.50 + 21.00 + 2.50 + 1.00 (S-5 left, left-wing canopy edges) and 1.00 + 2.00 + 5.25 x 4 + 2.00 + 1.00 = 27.00 (S-5 right, main-hall roof edges).

Two dummy lines are NOT printed: B'' (5.50) and D'''' (20.50) — the junction where the diagonal GB5 / GB9 / GB8 meet at x = 4.80. Its x is printed (6.00 - 1.20) but its y is taken on the straight line GB5 + GB9 drawn from 2/B''' to 3/B' (they read as one straight diagonal), flagged and scored 0.6.

B'''' (7.75) / D'' (18.25): the S-5 right chain prints 5.25 ticks there, and S-4 prints the stage-front GB8 as 10.50 long on line 2'' — 18.25 - 7.75 = 10.50, so both sheets agree on the same two points.

1'' (0.95) is the printed tick; the corner-toilet partition beams GB9/GB8 are drawn about 0.10 m right of it (≈1.05 scaled). They are recorded on 1'' rather than on an unprinted scaled line — warning repeated on the beam plan.

Dimension sweep covers the two structural sheets (แผ่นที่ 4, 5). The architectural sheets 1-3 and 6 (plans, elevations, sections, toilet/door details, furniture layout) were not swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run, so their room levels are not recorded. Member-internal dimensions (sections, footing plan sizes, truss panels 1.05 / 1.00, B1 cantilever 2.00, slab spans L = 3.05-4.00 etc.) stay on their elements.
Handwritten marks on the scan (approval signatures, a pen note correcting มอก. 116-2529 to 1228-2537 on S-5) are not part of the grid.
